title: Depth sweep: DEPTH=12 vs baseline 8
description: Changed DEPTH from 8 to 12 (model_dim scales to 768 via ASPECT_RATIO), and reduced DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE from 128 to 64 (grad_accum doubled to keep TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE fixed) to avoid an OOM the first attempt hit at DEPTH=12/batch 128.
reflection: val_bpb 1.016240, slightly worse than the 1.014027 baseline. Going deeper (12 vs 8 layers) under this fixed 5-min wall-clock budget did not help: the extra capacity per step was outweighed by seeing fewer optimizer steps/tokens. This is a mild negative result, not a strong one (+0.0022 bpb), but combined with two other agents independently testing DEPTH=6 this round, it suggests depth=8 is close to a local optimum for this time budget and the search should look at other axes (LR schedule, batch size, architecture details) rather than depth in isolation. Note: changing DEPTH also forced a DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE change to avoid OOM, so this wasn't a perfectly clean single-variable test.
